payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reads tree edges to fill a degree array, then computes n * d[u] * d[v] % MOD using only the last edge's degrees, ignoring the rest of the tree.
payload.rationale: The code performs a trivial constant-time multiplication after reading input, with no recurrence, tree traversal, or DP table. It does not match any DP subtype, but dp_tree is chosen because candidate_families forces a dynamic programming label and it is the top-ranked subtype.
